why: Creator delivers red-pill monologue demeaning women as ego-driven and undeserving of respect, no distancing.
Uploader's own commentary endorses framing of the adulteress woman as a snare for fools.
Speaker threatens and mocks target's disability with 'crippled ass', no critical or quoting frame.
Educational recitation of unalienable rights; contains no identity-attacking material.
Uploader's title labels a woman with the mocking gendered epithet 'huachi niangmen', no distancing.
Satire explicitly refutes the gay-groomer stereotype and concludes gays are harmless to children.
Neutral explainer on qualities of a good general; no identity-attacking content at all.
Monologue asserts aimless zombie-like violence is inherent to black culture, presented as the video's own claim.
Creator plays a pink-wig 'mean girl' caricature as comedy, deploying a mocking female stereotype.
Raccoon-hunting dog and heartworm treatment story; 'coon' refers to the animal, no identity attack.
Gun-range reaction aimed at pedophiles and their euphemism, not at any protected identity group.
Animated satire criticises the character's slurs, framing such prejudice as really being classism.
Criticism of churches as untaxed businesses is institutional, not an attack on believers' identity.
Archival Dave Allen stand-up clip, explicitly attributed, whose joke targets the emigrating homophobe.
Creator enacts misogynistic phrases in order to expose and criticise them as unconscious sexism.
Ideological argument that sexism against men exists; mocks feminist reasoning, not women as a group.
White-nationalist narration dehumanises non-whites, denies the Holocaust and blames Jews, entirely in the creator's voice.
